description: Six clock dividers, each adding a fixed voltage to the output while it is in the first half of its division

params.text: Sets the division for that row, a whole number from 2 to 16; the row is active for the first half of each division and the light beside it shows when
The voltage that row adds to the output while it is active, -1V to 1V

inputs.text: A rising edge above 3V advances the step count by one
A rising edge returns the step count to zero

outputs.text: The offsets of every active row added together, -6V to 6V

notes: The step count rises only on a rising edge at the clock input, so with nothing patched there the output never changes
Every offset knob comes up at zero, so the output rests at 0V until at least one of them is moved
